candidates.name: PeekNamedPipe
verified_facts: PeekNamedPipe reads available data and byte counts without removing data from the pipe
Pipe wait mode does not change PeekNamedPipe behavior
semantic_limits: Peek can still block in some synchronous-handle scenarios and must be bounded externally

candidates.name: WaitNamedPipeW
verified_facts: WaitNamedPipe waits for a named-pipe instance to become available
The timeout can be explicit or use the server default
semantic_limits: Availability is not ownership or health evidence; waits must remain bounded

candidates.name: GetNamedPipeClientComputerNameW
verified_facts: GetNamedPipeClientComputerName returns the client computer name for a pipe
The result is tied to the supplied pipe instance
semantic_limits: Computer name is descriptive and does not authenticate the peer

candidates.name: Windows Event Log Functions
verified_facts: Windows Event Log functions cover query, iteration, rendering, provider metadata, and query diagnostics
Read functions are separate from export, subscription, and channel-configuration mutation
semantic_limits: Event APIs obey caller permissions and an empty result can reflect access scope

candidates.name: EvtQuery
verified_facts: EvtQuery retrieves events from a channel or log file using XPath or structured XML
Flags select channel versus file path and forward versus reverse direction
semantic_limits: A successful query handle does not guarantee every requested channel was accessible

candidates.name: EvtNext
verified_facts: EvtNext retrieves event handles from a query or subscription result set
The Timeout parameter bounds waiting for results
semantic_limits: Each returned event handle must be closed and the query must handle no-more-items separately

candidates.name: EvtRender
verified_facts: EvtRender can render event XML or selected values through a render context
A size-discovery call may be needed before allocating the output buffer
semantic_limits: Rendered XML must be parsed and correlated by provider, event ID, record ID, process, and time

candidates.name: EvtOpenPublisherMetadata
verified_facts: EvtOpenPublisherMetadata opens provider metadata used to format event messages
Locale and log-file context can affect metadata resolution
semantic_limits: Provider metadata availability does not prove the event message or localization is complete

candidates.name: EvtFormatMessage
verified_facts: EvtFormatMessage formats event or provider strings using publisher metadata
Different flags select event, level, task, opcode, keyword, channel, provider, or XML output
semantic_limits: Formatted text is presentation evidence; structured XML fields remain authoritative

candidates.name: EvtGetQueryInfo
verified_facts: EvtGetQueryInfo reports query paths and per-path status values
It can expose channels or files that a structured query failed to access
semantic_limits: Query result events are incomplete if any required path has a failing status

candidates.name: QueryAllTracesW
verified_facts: QueryAllTraces retrieves properties and statistics for ETW sessions the caller can query
The caller supplies an array of EVENT_TRACE_PROPERTIES buffers and receives a logger count
semantic_limits: Private or inaccessible sessions can be absent and must not be treated as globally nonexistent

candidates.name: ControlTraceW
verified_facts: ControlTrace with EVENT_TRACE_CONTROL_QUERY retrieves properties and statistics for one session
Other control codes update, flush, or stop sessions and are outside this read-only package
semantic_limits: A query result must record access errors and must never automatically stop a session

candidates.name: EVENT_TRACE_PROPERTIES
verified_facts: EVENT_TRACE_PROPERTIES carries session configuration and statistics including buffers and events lost
EventsLost indicates data loss when buffers cannot keep up
semantic_limits: Zero events lost does not prove the expected provider or process was enabled

candidates.name: QueryTraceW
verified_facts: QueryTrace retrieves properties and statistics for a specified tracing session
The caller must provide a correctly sized EVENT_TRACE_PROPERTIES buffer
semantic_limits: Session-name matching does not establish ownership by the canonical runner
